title: Wildfire Smoke and Your Patients' Health: The Air Quality Index
claims: Symptoms such as coughing, wheezing or shortness of breath are a sign to immediately reduce exposure to smoke.
If it looks or smells smoky outside, try to stay indoors or find a cleaner air shelter.
The guidance advises avoiding strenuous activities such as mowing the lawn or going for a run when it looks or smells smoky.
The NowCast AQI can indicate whether activities should be limited and how.
